notes.title: Steam Zombies VS Vampires Fest
notes.content:
I announce that Seniorita Chupacabra is taking part in the Fest Vampire Vs Zombies on Steam!

What you noticed project name was corrected, previously Seniorita El Chupacabra sounded cool but was incorrect :(

I was working on a new version of the demo but the last polishing required time so I will try my best to show a new version of the demo during the festival.

The incoming demo version will be numbered 0.7.

It contains:
- replayable gameplay with random enemy positions and different locations in some areas;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186343/bbb04d33fb71a3c3931ce4bb3c3faaf29dda55bb.png[/img]
- artefacts: new items that allow casting spells from other races on the highest level without using mana;
- new game mode: "Cursed treasure"

[b]* Cursed Treasure *[/b]
-Is a game mode where players can choose what kind of character wanna play, our protagonist Maria Chupacabra is unavailable because she is OP.

The goal is to earn 1000 gold but the problem is that the game has a day and night mode also every time a new level is generated.
In the daytime, players can visit randomly chosen locations from the main game, but all opponents are zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186343/d39eff4e03245015490bf2cc38b3fccc3d70acf7.png[/img]
In the nighttime, on the border of the level map, zombies are spawning and have small bonuses to their stats.
Players have a base in the centre of the level where zombies are storming, in the morning players can find there First aid kit and the possibility to buy and improve their inventory.

So the current festival inspired me for that game mode and zombies become also a new opponent in the main game in some cursed locations.

As for zombies, there are slow brutes, our protagonist can take control of them like other opponents and for now there is no planned Zombie-Boss (or maybe?).

notes.title: These majestic elves | DevLog #10
notes.content:
I finally added elves to my shooter game on Wild West, now when I add the last opponent type, I can polish my game.

Elves are high-agility creatures that prefer range fight to melee because their health is low.
Weapon and spell presentation in video.

[previewyoutube=8O3IsqHaxG0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Protagonist can use them for example:
- treatment;
- reach high levels;
- getting to higher levels of the map.

Now it's time to add A.I. for opponents!
